bullets.text: Samsung & SoftBank's AI-RAN Pact - **Samsung** and **SoftBank** collaborate on 6G and AI-driven RAN technologies to enhance telecom innovation.
Vodafone's AI for 5G Operations - **Vodafone** partners with Zinkworks to automate 5G network management using generative AI.
MasOrange Surpasses Synergy Goals - **MasOrange** achieves €259 million in synergies ahead of schedule post-merger.
T-Mobile's Record Growth - **T-Mobile US** reports record 2.35 million postpaid customer additions in Q3 2025.
Vodafone's Open RAN Expansion - **Vodafone** collaborates with **Wind River** to deploy Open RAN across Germany.
PSTN Switch-Off Deadline Approaches - UK businesses must transition to all-IP networks by January 2027 to avoid disruptions.
Black Sea Cable Project Announced - **Vodafone Group** plans a €116 million submarine cable to enhance connectivity in the Black Sea.
Digital Twin Tech for Towers - Digital twin technology enhances tower management, enabling smarter decision-making and operational efficiency.
AI's Role in Telecom Transformation - **EY's** Rob Atkinson discusses the challenges and potential of AI in telecom at Connected Britain.
